mapper.insert: insert into file_history (file_name, course_sum, upload_time, state, student_info_id) values (#{fileName}, #{courseSum}, #{uploadTime}, #{state}, #{studentInfoId})
mapper.select: select id, file_name, course_sum, upload_time, state, student_info_id from file_history where student_info_id = #{studentInfoId} order by upload_time desc, id desc
